turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for candidates who reached the interview stage or beyond, so I cannot give that share; the closest figures are applications (3 applications for 1 to 30 September 2026) and candidates in stage, which counts the stage held on a given day rather than whether a candidate passed through interview. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
